items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: The name 'Monk' appears only as the interviewer's name ('My name is Monk Rowe'). The interviewee addresses him as 'Monk', indicating a professional acquaintance or familiarity with the interviewer, but there is no evidence of a musical or personal relationship with the jazz pianist Thelonious Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I am in Hamilton College in Clinton, New York, and I’m talking to Adrian Cunningham in Harlem. Welcome.
Good to be here, Monk. Thanks for having me.

You’re welcome. And I practiced an introduction, so here we go: Adrian Cunningham, saxophonist, flautist, clarinetist, composer, band leader, writer, humorist, occasional vocalist and world traveler. So did I leave anything out?
